source.description:
PROBLEM: The operator needs a second live activation to try /fleet inspect (keyboard navigator, Enter-attach) after arrow activation proved dead.

SUCCESS: An explorer activation runs for one to three minutes while the operator opens the inspector with /fleet inspect and reports what works.

SCOPE: One read-only explorer run: list the five largest files under src/ with one line each on what it does, under 120 words. No edits.

NON_GOALS: No implementation, no fixes -- observations become follow-ups.

CONSTRAINTS: READ_ONLY. Short run only.

VALIDATION: Activation settles PASS; operator reports inspector behavior.

OUTPUT: Micro-report plus operator observation in bead notes.

SCRUTINY: low
source.title: Live-TUI probe 2: inspector check via /fleet inspect
